posts.author: Arcaines
posts.body:
In all my years on here, I've never heard of a Vocal version for Theme 3 or any other song in RPG maker.
Are you sure it's part of the original resource? I mean naming a song Theme 1,2,3 or 4 etc is quite common and could literally be another song with the same name as Theme 3.
